simulation_limits: Blinded asynchronous agent using canonical transcripts, not a real human table test. No live improvisation, measured timing, or human recall test. Ending withheld; no other ballots available in this folder.
experience: Welcoming host can also solve the case from current-round evidence. Motive was broad; Opportunity narrowed to five; Method supplied a unique intersection. Tracking sixteen ticks is straightforward in a transcript but would compete with listening, checking attendance and finding question rows live.

questions_answer_matching.assessment: All named questions matched the answers in each observed chain. Questions ask exactly the facts required by the reports. Preparation records repeat and substantiate Opportunity facts in Method.
questions_answer_matching.weakness: Method asks supplies and use, but the required read-aloud record is not explicitly requested by the question; a reader could stop after the narrative unless the facilitator cues it.

remembering_animals: DUCK remained distinct from HIPPO in this text simulation; that does not test human memory across a social evening. Announcing HIPPO twice and returning slips prevents visible identity tracking. Guide has explicit forgotten-animal recovery, but a full redraw before selection may be disruptive. No actual forgotten animal occurred.
duplicate_questions: Shared groups produce repeated question wording, as Sue and Chip both receive the same Motive question; answers differ and no respondent was asked twice. Repetition helps consistency but Opportunity/Method become procedural after several turns. Do not remove repeated questioning if it risks omitting a guest.
note_taking: Saved chronological hypotheses; would prefer a personal grid Name / salon time / key / linen / motive. Existing lined notes support prose but do not help compare sixteen names efficiently. Method records allow recovery if an earlier answer was missed.
host_divided_attention: Actual kit includes named attendance/round checklist and counts-match ballot tally. These address chain tracking and reveal collection. Host still listens to evidence and turns pages while ticking. All observed chains completed without intervention.

round_timing_estimated_not_measured.motive_minutes: 12–18 for sixteen question-answer turns plus brief discussion
round_timing_estimated_not_measured.basis: Estimated spoken reading and handoffs only; no measured party timings. Host agenda allowances of20/30/30 minutes look feasible for sixteen with restrained speeches. Thirty would materially increase reading burden.

actual_public_utterances: Exact canonical Artie answers and outgoing questions are in arrival-notes, motive-notes, opportunity-notes and method-notes. No additional improvised testimony was made.

host_ballot_simulation.instructions: Collect all sixteen ballots privately before opening Coming Clean; lock without revisions. Then rank only positive totals descending, breaking ties alphabetically by full character name, taking at most three. Partial tally has only Elon with one vote; it cannot establish final top three. Each chosen suspect reads own appropriate box even if an earlier confession occurs. If none confesses, announce selected HIPPO and ask its memorizer to read murderer confession. Do not announce HIPPO fallback after a confession.
